scope: Exhaustively measure the frozen repaired right eye against every retained V34 right-upper component and every V14 right-lower component. Use exact OCCT common operations for solid components and strict AABB separation proofs only when a frozen OBJ cannot be sewn as an OCCT solid. Create deterministic JSON evidence only.

numeric_contract.acceptance: Zero positive eye-versus-shell intersections above threshold; zero unresolved Boolean or reconstruction errors; every source hash verified; any non-sewn OBJ must have a strictly positive AABB separation lower bound proving collision is impossible.

allowed_actions: Open hash-pinned FCStd and STEP sources read-only
Reconstruct hash-pinned lower OBJ tessellations as in-memory OCCT solids without healing or coordinate changes
Run exact OCCT common and distance operations
Use a strict AABB separation lower bound as a no-collision proof for a non-sewn frozen OBJ
Write deterministic validation JSON and a Markdown checkpoint
prohibited_actions: Move, rotate, scale, trim, cut, fuse, heal, mirror, remesh, or otherwise change geometry
Create or modify a FreeCAD document
Export STL, 3MF, G-code, or production geometry
Approve printing or release structural ASA G-code
release_holds: V35 is read-only collision evidence, not geometry approval
Every positive contact must be dispositioned and revalidated
Containment/exterior-protrusion, insertion path, bilateral, service, topology, slicer, and physical tests remain separate
